Paddle through the kelp forest canopy along Cannery Row and experience the Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary. You may be greeted by harbor seals swimming alongside you or resting sleepily on the rocks along the shore. Or you may witness a raft of otters rolling and playing in the kelp! services.name: Private Cannery Row Kayak Tour
services.desc: About Tours start in the heart of the Cannery Row kelp forest and visit the resident raft of otters right in front of the shop! This location is located a short paddle from both the Aquarium and the Coast Guard pier – both areas are prime for wildlife viewing. We can almost guarantee you will see otters, harbor seals and sea lions. We Provide: A professional guide A dry bag for a phone or camera to take pictures Paddling and wildlife orientation. blurb: Adventures by the Sea provides visitors and locals the opportunity to discover Monterey by land and sea through rentals and tours of bikes, electric bikes, kayaks, surreys, and stand-up paddle boards. They have five locations throughout the Monterey Peninsula, including near Fisherman's Wharf and Cannery Row. Activities include spotting otters, biking the 17-Mile Drive, and family-friendly adventures.
